details.method: Exercise actual continuation cancellation at each asynchronous currentness phase and cold restart through a new operation ID to final downstream acceptance; require explicit terminal operation receipts and preserve original history.
details.when: A parent production operation spans producer and reviewer currentness jobs or survives an editor restart.
details.counterexample: Cancelling only the first validation phase can miss a later orphan operation; status eligibility or an overall fixture success flag does not prove the new operation dispatched or its dependency resumed.
details.trial_plan: Repeat isolated native fixtures that stop during producer and reviewer validation, assert no parent repair budget or extra launch, restart an in-flight operation, require new-ID context_recorded, then explicitly resume the previously waiting sibling and require fresh acceptance before its first dispatch.
